scope: Read-only characterization of the legacy EOS reconstruction, core-crust matcher, CompOSE composition/Nadd semantics, sharp Maxwell/Gibbs paths, and phase-aware TOV/Love implementation. No source code or raw input was modified.

thermodynamic_contract.rest_mass_alignment: Only shift the crust energy-per-baryon zero by delta_m = m_n(core)-m_n(crust); do not apply the historical empirical +4.96005 MeV GM1 or +2.45 MeV FSU2 offsets whose provenance is unestablished.
thermodynamic_contract.candidate_window: The legacy two-plane secant inequalities are a screening heuristic, not a theorem for convexity, causality or stability. The historical fallback core locator uses n_B >= 0.045 fm^-3 when composition is unavailable; this is not a provider-independent physical phase boundary.

legacy_methods.construction: Hermite P(u) on u in [0,1], internal knots u={0.22,0.78}, pressure offset dP=0.015*(P2-P1), endpoint slopes bounded relative to secants; solve Pt from Delta x*integral_0^1[P(u)/n(u)]du=F2-F1.
legacy_methods.physics: A smooth single-valued barotrope with continuous n_B; no exact common-pressure/common-mu coexistence and no latent heat. Delta n_B=0. It is not a first-order Maxwell transition.
legacy_methods.numerical_limit: Historical root uses 64-point whole-interval Gauss-Legendre quadrature; F(u) uses 16-point whole-interval quadrature without splitting at u=0.22 and 0.78. Endpoint first-law closure does not certify the interior F profile. Keep only as immutable legacy parity until knot-split/adaptive or analytic quadrature is validated.
legacy_methods.production_name_policy: Preserve under legacy_npphb. Never use the historical maxwell token as a sharp Maxwell label; sharp_maxwell is a separate operation.

legacy_methods.construction: Two-segment constant-sound-speed bridge in (mu_B,n_B). The internal knot is chosen by a scalar root so the analytic integral of n_B dmu_B reproduces P2-P1. Each segment has constant c_s^2=Delta ln(mu_B)/Delta ln(n_B); generally the two segment values differ.
legacy_methods.regularity: Piecewise constant c_s^2, with a possible change at the internal knot; not a density-jump phase transition.

legacy_methods.construction: Use x=ln(n_B), interpolate Q1=P/n_B with a cubic Hermite bridge, impose the average Q1 integral (F2-F1)/Delta x, then F=F1+Delta x*integral(Q1 du), P=n_B Q1, mu_B=F+Q1.
legacy_methods.regularity: Cubic Hermite/free-energy bridge; endpoint derivative/sound-speed equality is not enforced exactly.

legacy_methods.construction: Same thermodynamic variable and integral constraint as cubic_F, but a fifth-order potential or adaptive boundary-layer C2 Hermite bridge preserves the exact endpoint derivatives of Q1.
legacy_methods.regularity: C2 endpoint slope matching; the bridge remains a continuous-density barotrope.

legacy_methods.construction: Use mu_B as the independent variable, interpolate n_B(mu_B) with a cubic Hermite bridge and impose integral n_B dmu_B=P2-P1. Recover P, Q1=P/n_B, F=mu_B-Q1.
legacy_methods.regularity: Cubic Hermite density-vs-chemical-potential bridge; endpoint sound-speed equality is not enforced exactly.

legacy_methods.construction: Same n_B(mu_B) integral constraint as cubic_P, with fifth-order potential or adaptive C2 Hermite bridge preserving exact endpoint derivatives.
legacy_methods.regularity: C2 endpoint slope matching; still a continuous-density barotrope.

component_construction_findings.legacy_api: The audited legacy path has no separate explicit standalone core_only/crust_only constructor. match_crust_core slices the chosen source tables at i1/i2 and constructs the bridge; reconstruct_master transforms the full supplied table.
component_construction_findings.core_selection: If composition is available, first is_homogeneous row with n_B>=0.03 fm^-3; otherwise first n_B>=0.045 fm^-3. Treat both as legacy selection heuristics pending a source/provider-specific component boundary contract.
component_construction_findings.reconstruction_is_not_raw_copy: reconstruct_master may clip Yp/Ymu/Yh; repair the last crust remnant/dissolution row; reconstruct Yn and charge closure; recompute electron/muon beta equilibrium; spline-smooth F=(Q6+1)m_n against ln(n_B); add an outer-crust electron plus Wigner-Seitz lattice pressure patch; recompute Q3/Q4/Q6/Q7 and optional q_extra=c_s^2. Its output must be a distinct versioned reconstructed artifact, never overwrite raw source.
component_construction_findings.core_composition_mode: strict_thermo_only is default and leaves absent/unusable core composition absent. literature_beta_eq is an explicit parabolic-symmetry-energy opt-in only for APR_APR and BBB_BHF2; do not silently apply it to other cores.
component_construction_findings.bridge_composition: When enabled, composition fields are bridged with a quintic smootherstep sigma=6u^5-15u^4+10u^3; cluster abundance/charge are faded from the crust boundary and lepton fractions solved with electron-muon equilibrium. Iphase bridge labels inherit the crust-end category, not a universal phase meaning.

compose_semantics.group_abundance: CompOSE Y_I is the group number abundance; internal Y_h=Abar*Y_I is the group baryon fraction.
compose_semantics.phase: Iphase is a provider-defined categorical field; numeric IDs are not universal phase names.
compose_semantics.missingness: An absent field/record is not a measured zero. Use row/species/group presence masks and separate NOT_AVAILABLE/PARTIAL/CHECKED/FAIL.
compose_semantics.provider_deviation: SPG/GPPVA raw group tuple values do not satisfy the literal CompOSE Y_I interpretation consistently. The resolved dual-track decision is: preserve raw tokens and apply the standard parser/mask rule (flag inconsistent rows); for production reconstruct composition from published CLD/Thomas-Fermi plus model RMF physics rather than globally remapping the provider field.
compose_semantics.production_reconstruction: The M3 CLD reconstruction pipeline is reported operational, with GPPVA_DD2 inner crust reconstructed. This is a Python/reference workstream, not proof that the full native Fortran production path or all 13 crusts are complete.

nadd.meaning: Nadd counts provider-defined eos.thermo extension columns.
nadd.legacy_python: The inspected legacy EOSData/CompOSE writer supports only Nadd=0 or 1.
nadd.current_native: The Fortran M10B work supports arbitrary Nadd>=0 in the internal representation/thermo export stages; full multi-axis composition and writer/readback remain pending.
nadd.categorical_warning: Categorical q_extra values (e.g. pasta geometry) are not continuous interpolation variables; do not interpolate them as scalars.

q3_il.Il_1: On the supported cold beta-equilibrium branch, mu_B=(Q3+1)*m_n and Q5 is approximately zero.
q3_il.Il_0: The Euler baryon chemical potential includes the charge term: mu_Euler=(Q3+1)*m_n + Yq*Q4*m_n.
q3_il.tolerance: Keep source/reconstruction algebraic tolerances distinct from sharp-interface coexistence tolerances.

phase_and_stellar_semantics.sharp_maxwell: Two locally charge-neutral phase barotropes require a common mu_B interval and solve P_low(mu_B)=P_high(mu_B). At coexistence P and mu_B agree, n_high>n_low>0, epsilon_i=mu_t*n_i-P_t and Delta epsilon=mu_t*Delta n_B>0. Multiple roots must be surfaced, not selected silently.
phase_and_stellar_semantics.gibbs: Global-neutrality mixed phase requires P(mu_B,mu_Q) surfaces, pressure equality and a volume-fraction neutrality root; a one-dimensional beta-equilibrated barotrope is insufficient.
phase_and_stellar_semantics.tidal: The legacy sharp-transition Love solver integrates the high branch to Pt, applies Delta y=-4*pi*r_t^3*Delta epsilon/(m_t+4*pi*r_t^3*P_t), then integrates the low branch. The reported Seidov result is only a small-core onset diagnostic, not a full radial-mode stability calculation.
phase_and_stellar_semantics.smooth_methods: All six historical matcher outputs are continuous-density single-valued barotropes; Seidov is not applicable.

historical_baseline.source: Dropbox EOS core-crust release v3.2 (2026-11-06), as recorded in DAG baseline; these are historical records, not newly re-executed results.
historical_baseline.known_full_table_failures: APR_APR and RG_KDE0v1 high-density C10 acausality. Preserve these failures; do not clip or relabel them as repaired microscopic EOS.
historical_baseline.source_matrix: 13 crust models x 5 core models x 6 legacy methods.

limitations: This is a static source audit and literature/schema reconciliation; it does not assert a fresh executable test or numerical replay.
The remote development device was Offline; no local compiler or pytest run was possible in this turn.
The six legacy Python methods are characterized, not yet ported into the native Fortran production matcher.
Standalone core-only and crust-only builder contracts and native builders are not explicit in the audited legacy API; they are added as a dedicated next DAG node.
The E390-00 source archive and historical outputs are preserved; no raw input or existing v3.2 output was modified.
